title: Quantifying Repair Risk in Crypto Option Surfaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.00958v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Option desks adjust crypto option quotes into price surfaces that remain within bid-ask intervals and satisfy standard no-arbitrage restrictions across strikes before computing Greeks, hedge quantities, or risk measures. For the same quote panel, however, these constraints may admit multiple such surfaces, which we call admissible repairs, with different downstream outputs. We define the resulting variation as repair risk and propose repair-risk validation, a matched framework for quantifying dispersion in Greeks, hedge quantities, and risk measures. The mechanism is finite-difference amplification: two admissible repairs within price distance $\varepsilon$ can differ in local normalized-strike curvature by $4\varepsilon/h^2$, where $h$ is local normalized-strike spacing. We evaluate repair risk on Deribit BTC and ETH option chains, using $L_1$ and $L_2$ projections of midpoint prices onto the same admissible set as matched controls.

translated_title: 量化加密期权曲面中的修复风险
translated_abstract: 期权交易台在计算希腊字母、对冲数量或风险度量之前，会将加密期权报价调整为保持在买卖价差区间内、并在各行权价间满足标准无套利约束的价格曲面。然而，对于同一报价面板，这些约束可能允许多个符合条件的曲面（我们称之为可容许修复），而不同曲面会产生不同的下游输出。我们将由此产生的变异定义为修复风险，并提出修复风险验证，这是一个用于量化希腊字母、对冲数量和风险度量离散程度的匹配框架。其机制是有限差分放大：价格距离为 $\varepsilon$ 的两个可容许修复，其局部归一化行权价曲率可相差 $4\varepsilon/h^2$，其中 $h$ 为局部归一化行权价间距。我们在 Deribit 的 BTC 和 ETH 期权链上评估修复风险，并将中点价格在同一可容许集合上的 $L_1$ 和 $L_2$ 投影作为匹配对照组。
tldr: 该论文提出“修复风险”概念——同一加密期权报价在满足买卖价差与无套利约束下可能存在多个可容许修复曲面，导致希腊字母与风险度量产生显著差异（经有限差分放大机制可放大至 $4\varepsilon/h^2$），并建立修复风险验证框架在 Deribit BTC/ETH 期权链上量化这种离散性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "repair risk"—the dispersion in Greeks, hedge quantities, and risk measures arising from multiple admissible repaired crypto option surfaces satisfying the same bid-ask and no-arbitrage constraints—and proposes a repair-risk validation framework, showing finite-difference amplification of curvature differences up to $4\varepsilon/h^2$, validated on Deribit BTC and ETH option chains.
